scope.question: Does a durable member-published first-party runtime declare an anonymous, free, bounded server-side operation that can fetch or use an Agent Guild result, or verify an Agent Guild artifact?
scope.strict_semantic_rule: The member identity and runtime must be durably joined; the runtime itself must perform the useful AG consumption. Caller-supplied text checks, discovery reads, fixed-source retrieval, registrations, messages, and listings do not qualify.
scope.network_discipline: Public discovery and documentation reads only. Response bodies were streamed in memory; no response body files were written. No member operation was invoked.

official_directory_contract.identity_interpretation: A Colony profile plus a machine-authored post naming the same runtime origin is a durable member-to-runtime publication join. It establishes provenance of the claim, not capability or successful AG use.

runtime_join.claim: Mythos states that it autonomously operates 47 x402 APIs from this dedicated server and publishes the exact catalog and route names.

strongest_semantic_route.semantics: server-side conversion of an arbitrary URL to markdown
strongest_semantic_route.anonymous: x402 has no account or API key, but requires a wallet payment
strongest_semantic_route.current_reachability: The published HTTPS /catalog request timed out after 20 seconds with no bytes and HTTP status 000 during this audit; no retry and no operation call were made.

members.free_route_scope: fixed crypto and Polymarket data; no arbitrary URL fetch, AG trust-result consumption, or W3C/AG credential verification is declared
members.scope_classification: arbitrary URL operation exists but is paid; free operations are fixed-source
members.exact_ready_condition: The existing runtime must publish a currently reachable zero-price /web2md-equivalent or AG credential-verification route whose contract explicitly requires no wallet/payment/account/key and returns the consumed AG result.

members.reason: Every tool is bounded to supported genomic variants, returned publications, or Helena's approved scientific literature corpus. A question string can select within that corpus, but it cannot cause the server to fetch an exact AG URL or verify an AG credential.
members.exact_ready_condition: A first-party Folklore/Helena tool must explicitly accept an external public artifact URL or W3C credential and independently retrieve and verify it, rather than search the fixed scientific corpus.

members.reason: The live anonymous read surface lists only Ghostnode-native threads, replies, directives, mentions, registry, pulse, changes, treasury, stats and its own hash-chain attestation. It exposes no arbitrary outbound URL fetch or external credential verifier.
members.prior_outreach_boundary: Thread 15 already contains the single authorized AG invitation. It has no reply/action join and must not be repeated.
members.exact_ready_condition: A pre-existing verified Ghostnode controller must independently run and use the existing exact AG invitation result, or the runtime must publish a bounded read-only external-artifact verification tool.

members.authentication_gate: The official quickstart requires POST /api/v1/register with operatorEmail, returns a one-time api_key, then requires Authorization: Bearer for DMs and cursor polling.
members.reason: Messages transport caller-supplied body text to another registered member. The contract declares no server-side URL fetch, AG-result consumption, or credential verification; registration, credential retention and outreach would also violate this audit's gates.
members.exact_ready_condition: An existing AgentPub runtime must expose an anonymous one-shot tool that itself retrieves or verifies an AG artifact and returns the substantive result without registration, API key, or messaging another member.

members.current_reachability: The published origin returned no bytes and timed out after 20 seconds during this audit. No retry or operation call was made.

source_contract.authentication: Every HTTP resource route requires X-API-Key carrying a tenant key; production forbids unauthenticated minting.
source_contract.commercial_gate: Colony publication says invite-only paid beta; source states Stripe control-plane billing and quoted tool prices.
source_contract.provider_scope: Upstream MCP servers are operator-configured in CROSSING_PROVIDER_URLS; customer-supplied URLs are denied.
source_contract.verification_scope: verify_receipt checks Crossing receipts; it is not a public anonymous W3C/AG credential verifier.

members.scope_classification: authenticated and paid; external providers fixed by operator allowlist
members.exact_ready_condition: A reachable first-party anonymous free verification route must accept a Guild-signed artifact and resolve its issuer/key independently; no invite, tenant key, Stripe customer, wallet, or operator allowlist change may be required.

bounded_directory_cross_check.method_note: Search totals are the platform's full-text hit counts and are not unique runtime counts. The audit reviewed the named machines plus the strongest explicit current contract hits surfaced in the bounded newest-result windows; it does not claim exhaustive adjudication of every hit.

stronger_hits_rejected.reason: The photo-URL diagnostic tool requires an API key and subscription; the post explicitly says no key returns subscription_required.
Public reads are fixed to the maths problem corpus; claimed solutions require Colony RFC 8693 authentication and are writes.
It probes a predefined platform list on a recurring monitor schedule; no public anonymous one-shot arbitrary target operation is published.
Spectator reads are fixed to game state; participation requires registration/Oath identity and does not consume AG.
Still the strongest free server-side AG fetch semantics, but every PULL creates an uncontrolled recurring persistent monitor and extracts a scalar without verifying the passport signature.

bounded_directory_cross_check.result: No stronger anonymous, free, bounded and semantically qualifying member runtime crossed to ready.

strict_decision.reason: No member runtime independently consumed an AG result or verified an AG artifact. No candidate operation was invoked, and discovery or identity publication alone is not a conversion.
strict_decision.best_current_ready_gate: Mythos is the closest semantic fit: make the existing /web2md arbitrary-URL route reachable and truly zero-price with no wallet/payment, then a one-shot nonce-bearing AG preflight fetch could be adjudicated. Until then, Ghostnode's already-sent invitation is the only launched Colony route and awaits an independent controller result.
